title: Routeur SONiC
description: Tout ce que le collecteur relève sur un routeur SONiC.

list.name: node
list.label: Routeur
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "lab_sonic_port" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE $timeFilter
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "lab_sonic_port" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE $timeFilter

list.name: port
list.label: Interfaces
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "lab_interface" WITH KEY = "interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "if_type" != 'wire' AND ("linked" = 'yes' OR "if_type" =~ /^(vlan|lag|loopback)$/) AND $timeFilter
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "lab_interface" WITH KEY = "interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "if_type" != 'wire' AND ("linked" = 'yes' OR "if_type" =~ /^(vlan|lag|loopback)$/) AND $timeFilter

targets.query: SELECT last("sonic_version") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("frr_version") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("hwsku") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("uptime_s") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m
SELECT last("ready") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m

panels.title: Services en échec
panels.description: Programmes supervisord en FATAL ou BACKOFF.

targets.query: SELECT sum("failed") FROM (SELECT last("failed") AS "failed" FROM "lab_sonic_service" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "service")
SELECT sum("e") FROM (SELECT last("established") AS "e" FROM "lab_bgp_peer" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "vrf", "peer")
SELECT count("e") FROM (SELECT last("established") AS "e" FROM "lab_bgp_peer" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "vrf", "peer")

panels.title: État des ports (CONFIG_DB, APPL_DB, STATE_DB)
panels.description: Tous les ports du routeur, câblés ou non. Un port est câblé quand un fil containerlab (ethN) lui correspond.

targets.query: SELECT last("index") AS "index", last("admin_up") AS "admin", last("oper_up") AS "oper", last("speed_mbps") AS "speed", last("mtu") AS "mtu", last("description") AS "description", last("cabled") AS "cabled", last("appl_flap_count") AS "flaps", last("lanes") AS "lanes" FROM "lab_sonic_port" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "port", "alias", "wire"

panels.title: Débit par interface
panels.description: Compteurs noyau des ports SONiC : émission (tx) au-dessus de l'axe, réception (rx) en dessous.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rx_bps") AS "rx", mean("tx_bps") AS "tx" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "interface" =~ /^$port$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)
SELECT mean("rx_pps") AS "rx", mean("tx_pps") AS "tx" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "interface" =~ /^$port$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)

SELECT mean("rx_errors_ps") AS "rx erreurs", mean("tx_errors_ps") AS "tx erreurs", mean("rx_dropped_ps") AS "rx pertes", mean("tx_dropped_ps") AS "tx pertes" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "interface" =~ /^$port$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)

panels.title: Utilisation des ports
panels.description: Débit rapporté à la vitesse configurée du port (CONFIG_DB).

targets.query: SELECT mean("rx_util_pct") AS "rx", mean("tx_util_pct") AS "tx" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "interface" =~ /^$port$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)

panels.title: Compteurs SAI des ports (COUNTERS_DB)
panels.description: Compteurs natifs de SONiC (flex counters PORT_STAT), ceux de « show interfaces counters ».

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("SAI_PORT_STAT_IF_IN_OCTETS"), 1s) * 8 AS "in", non_negative_derivative(last("SAI_PORT_STAT_IF_OUT_OCTETS"), 1s) * 8 AS "out" FROM "lab_sonic_counters" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "source" = 'COUNTERS' AND "object_type" = 'PORT' AND "object" =~ /^$port$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "object" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("SAI_PORT_STAT_IF_IN_DISCARDS"), 1s) AS "in rejets", non_negative_derivative(last("SAI_PORT_STAT_IF_IN_ERRORS"), 1s) AS "in erreurs", non_negative_derivative(last("SAI_PORT_STAT_IF_OUT_DISCARDS"), 1s) AS "out rejets", non_negative_derivative(last("SAI_PORT_STAT_IF_OUT_ERRORS"), 1s) AS "out erreurs" FROM "lab_sonic_counters" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "source" = 'COUNTERS' AND "object_type" = 'PORT' AND "object" =~ /^$port$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "object" fill(null)
SELECT last("state_code") FROM "lab_bgp_peer" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "vrf", "peer" fill(previous)

SELECT last("state") AS "state", last("uptime_s") AS "uptime", last("description") AS "description", last("connections_established") AS "est", last("connections_dropped") AS "dropped", last("last_reset") AS "reset", last("rtt_ms") AS "rtt", last("hold_time_s") AS "hold" FROM "lab_bgp_peer" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "vrf", "peer", "remote_as", "peer_type"
SELECT last("pfx_rcd") AS "reçus", last("pfx_snt") AS "envoyés" FROM "lab_bgp_afi" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "peer", "afi" fill(previous)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("updates_recv"), 1s) AS "updates reçus", non_negative_derivative(last("updates_sent"), 1s) AS "updates envoyés", non_negative_derivative(last("keepalives_recv"), 1s) AS "keepalives reçus", non_negative_derivative(last("keepalives_sent"), 1s) AS "keepalives envoyés", non_negative_derivative(last("notifications_recv"), 1s) AS "notifications reçues", non_negative_derivative(last("notifications_sent"), 1s) AS "notifications envoyées" FROM "lab_bgp_peer" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "peer" fill(null)

panels.title: RTT TCP estimé par FRR (ms)
panels.description: Estimation de FRR à partir de la session TCP (souvent 0 dans un lab : moins d'une milliseconde).

targets.query: SELECT mean("rtt_ms") FROM "lab_bgp_peer" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "peer" fill(null)
SELECT last("fib") FROM "lab_route" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "protocol" != 'total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "afi", "protocol" fill(previous)

panels.title: Programmation des routes : FRR → APPL_DB → ASIC_DB
panels.description: FRR pousse ses routes vers APPL_DB (fpmsyncd), orchagent les programme dans ASIC_DB. Les totaux diffèrent par construction (routes noyau, connectées, management), mais doivent bouger ensemble.

targets.query: SELECT sum("fib") FROM (SELECT last("fib") AS "fib" FROM "lab_route" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "protocol" = 'total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "afi", "vrf") GROUP BY time($__interval)
SELECT last("keys") FROM "lab_sonic_db" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "db" = 'APPL_DB' AND "table" = 'ROUTE_TABLE' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("keys") FROM "lab_sonic_db" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "db" = 'ASIC_DB' AND "table" = 'ASIC_STATE:SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_ROUTE_ENTRY' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

SELECT sum("count") FROM (SELECT last("count") AS "count" FROM "lab_neighbor" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface", "family", "state") GROUP BY time($__interval), "family", "state"

SELECT last("via") AS "via", last("interfaces") AS "ifaces", last("distance") AS "distance", last("metric") AS "metric", last("selected") AS "selected", last("installed") AS "installed", last("uptime_s") AS "age" FROM "lab_route_entry" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "vrf", "afi", "prefix", "protocol"

panels.title: Ressources CRM utilisées
panels.description: Critical Resource Monitoring : entrées utilisées sur la capacité de l'ASIC (virtuel ici).

targets.query: SELECT last("used_pct") FROM "lab_sonic_crm" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "stage" = '' AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "resource"

panels.title: Clés par base et par table
panels.description: Toutes les bases redis de SONiC. Une table qui apparaît (VLAN, PORTCHANNEL, ACL…) est relevée sans configuration.

targets.query: SELECT last("keys") AS "keys" FROM "lab_sonic_db" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "db", "table"
SELECT mean("used_memory") FROM "lab_sonic_redis" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("instantaneous_ops_per_sec") FROM "lab_sonic_redis" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("connected_clients") FROM "lab_sonic_redis" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Voisins LLDP
panels.description: Dans cette image, LLDP ne voit que le réseau de management (eth0).

targets.query: SELECT last("remote_mgmt_ip") AS "mgmt", last("remote_port_id") AS "port_id", last("remote_chassis_id") AS "chassis" FROM "lab_sonic_lldp" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "local_port", "remote_system", "remote_port"

SELECT last("received") AS "received", last("admitted") AS "admitted", last("dropped_allowlist") AS "dropped" FROM "lab_sonic_counters" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "source" = 'NOTIFICATION_CONSUMER_STATS' AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "object_type", "object"

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Certains programmes s'arrêtent normalement après le démarrage (EXITED : start.sh, zsocket…) ou ne démarrent pas dans cette image (STOPPED).

targets.query: SELECT last("state_code") AS "state", last("uptime_s") AS "uptime", last("cpu_pct") AS "cpu", last("rss_bytes") AS "rss", last("threads") AS "threads", last("processes") AS "procs", last("fds") AS "fds", last("pid") AS "pid" FROM "lab_sonic_service" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "service"

panels.title: CPU par service
panels.description: Temps CPU du programme et de ses processus fils, en % d'un cœur.

targets.query: SELECT mean("cpu_pct") FROM "lab_sonic_service" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "service" fill(null)
SELECT mean("rss_bytes") FROM "lab_sonic_service" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "running" = 1 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "service" fill(null)

panels.title: État des services
panels.description: Un programme qui passe en BACKOFF ou FATAL apparaît en orange ou en rouge.

targets.query: SELECT last("state_code") FROM "lab_sonic_service" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "service" fill(previous)

SELECT sum("rate") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("lines_total"), 1m) AS "rate" FROM "lab_syslog" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "program", "severity") GROUP BY time($__interval), "severity"

SELECT sum("rate") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("lines_total"), 1m) AS "rate" FROM "lab_syslog" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "program", "severity") GROUP BY time($__interval), "program"

panels.title: Événements du routeur
panels.description: Les 100 derniers événements du routeur, quelle que soit la période affichée : lignes de syslog notables (ports, bootstrap) et changements d'état détectés par le collecteur (BGP, nœud).

targets.query: SELECT "type", "severity", "program", "message" FROM "lab_event" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 30d ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT mean("usage_percent") FROM "docker_container_cpu" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "cpu" = 'cpu-total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage") FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("limit") FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("rx_bytes"), 1s) * 8 AS "rx", non_negative_derivative(last("tx_bytes"), 1s) * 8 AS "tx" FROM "docker_container_net" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "network" = 'total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
